## automotive_dealership_poster

> Point-of-sale dealership poster — vehicle hero plus price, financing terms, and dealer name.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1280`, aspect `4:5`
**Demo vars:** `templates/automotive/_vars_examples/automotive_dealership_poster.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A vertical point-of-sale poster for an independent dealership presenting the fictional compact electric crossover "Helio EV Mira 4". The vehicle hero plate sits in the upper portion of the canvas with the price, financing terms, and dealer name laid out as a clean typographic block beneath it — designed to read at a forecourt window or a showroom A-frame from across the lot.
[2. Action] The vehicle is photographed at rest in a held three-quarter showroom pose, wheels straight, doors closed, no driver. The viewer's eye lands on the hero shot, drops to the model name, and then registers the price marker, the financing line, and finally the dealer wordmark at the foot of the poster. There is no in-use scene, no test drive, no salesperson.
[3. Scene] Indoor showroom or controlled forecourt environment — pale polished concrete floor, neutral cyclorama wall, calm overhead daylight. A soft contact shadow grounds the chassis. No customers, no other vehicles, no real-brand signage, no rooftop banners; the poster is a flat retail print plate, not a candid showroom photograph.
[4. Composition] Vertical 4:5 frame. Hero zone (~60%) at the top holds the vehicle silhouette at three-quarter angle, centered horizontally, with generous side margin. Model name (~8%) sits directly below the hero. Price-and-financing block (~20%) holds the price in a large display weight and the financing terms in a smaller cross-line. Dealer footer (~6%) anchors the bottom edge in small caps. Safe margins of 5% on every side.
[5. Style] Honest dealer-retail aesthetic — confident, legible, never tabloid loud. Palette: a single neutral paper ground, deep ink, and one saturated accent tied to the dealer brand. Type system: a geometric sans for the model name and price, a humanist sans for the financing line, small caps for the dealer footer. No clip-art starbursts, no airbrushed gradient sky, no fake chrome bevels.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- model_name: "Helio EV Mira 4"
- price_str: "From $34,990"
- financing_str: "0.9% APR for 60 months"
- dealer_name: "Northrun Motors of Boulder"

Preserve (edit mode only):
- vehicle proportions
- price block legibility

NO: real automaker logos, real dealership chains, real-celebrity endorsers, human salespeople in frame, clip-art starbursts, lens flare, rainbow palette, watermarks, HDR oversaturation, 3D chrome bevels, airbrushed gradient skies, cluttered banner ribbons
```

## automotive_hero_ad

> Cinematic single-vehicle hero ad — fictional car, motorcycle, or EV on a deliberate backdrop.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1920x1088`, aspect `16:9`
**Demo vars:** `templates/automotive/_vars_examples/automotive_hero_ad.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A cinematic hero advertisement for the fictional grand tourer coupe "Northrun Atlas GT" finished in graphite slate. The vehicle is the sole protagonist of the frame — a single hero unit photographed at a confident three-quarter angle, occupying the dominant left two- thirds of the canvas while a quiet typographic margin runs down the right. No drivers, no riders, no passengers — just the machine.
[2. Action] The vehicle is at rest in a held campaign pose, wheels straight, body weight settled, no motion blur and no panning streak. The composition is purely still — this is a hero plate, not a motorsport action shot. Reflections curve across body panels to describe form; the badge or grille reads cleanly without becoming the focal point.
[3. Scene] The setting evokes high-altitude salt flat at blue hour — a controlled backdrop that flatters silhouette rather than tells a road-trip story. Sky and horizon fall into a graduated tonal wash; foreground is a clean surface (poured concrete, salt flat, studio cyclorama) with a soft contact shadow under the chassis. No bystanders, no other vehicles, no city signage, no real-world brand chrome.
[4. Composition] 16:9 hero canvas. Vehicle silhouette anchors the left two-thirds, framed at three-quarter angle with the front wheel a third of the way in from the left edge. Right third is reserved as quiet negative space holding the model name in display weight stacked above the tagline in a smaller editorial cut. Generous safe margins (6%) protect type from edge crop in OOH placements.
[5. Style] Premium automotive campaign aesthetic. Palette keyed to graphite slate body paint with one cool ambient and one warm rim accent — restrained, never lurid. Type system: a confident geometric sans for the model name and a refined editorial serif for the tagline. Lighting is cinematic but disciplined — soft key from upper-left, gentle wraparound fill, no theatrical lens flare, no chrome cliché, no rainbow gradient.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- model_name: "Northrun Atlas GT"
- tagline: "Built for the long horizon"

Preserve (edit mode only):
- vehicle silhouette and proportions
- body panel reflection geometry

NO: real automaker logos, real model badges, real-celebrity drivers, drivers or passengers visible, busy roadway traffic, storefront context, lens flare cliché, HDR oversaturation, rainbow palette, watermarks, 3D chrome reflections cliché, clip-art icons
```
